about.title: Who writes this blog
about.lead: Oussama Abid. He has lived in Montréal since 2018, and builds Krizaka there.
about.slot: The Wu-sama mark, my nickname, in place of a photo
body: My name is Oussama (Wu-sama, to my friends). I have lived in Montréal since 2018.
I studied mathematics and computer science, then turned to mathematics and computing applied to cognitive science. Put simply, how we think, how we learn, and what a machine can do with that.

In 2011 I did my first research internship in a lab, in natural language processing. Teaching a machine to read a sentence, pull out the facts, get at the meaning. Nobody talked about AI at parties back then. That's still where I started.
Then fifteen years building systems that run for real. Connected trains, healthcare apps for a hospital, mobile platforms for telecom operators, connected cities with millions of devices.

Today I build Krizaka, here in Montréal, with AI agents that I direct, review and correct. It comes full circle, a little: I met the machine that reads a sentence back in the lab, and now I put it to work.
When I'm not coding, I listen to jazz, go to concerts, travel when I can, and keep a game controller within reach.
This blog is what I learn while building. Short posts, with the numbers I can show, and what I haven't solved yet.
about.homeBody: My name is Oussama. I have lived in Montréal since 2018, and I build Krizaka there. My first brush with AI was in 2011, at the {lab}, long before the word was in fashion. Here I tell what I learn along the way.

privacy: Who: Technologies Krizaka Inc., doing business as Krizaka, Montréal (Québec), Canada. Contact: the form at www.krizaka.com/contact.
Why: only to send you an e-mail when a new post is published on this blog. Never sold, never shared, never used for anything else.
What: your e-mail address, the language you chose, and the date and way you gave your consent (the confirmation link). Nothing is recorded before you click that link.
Where: the list and the e-mails go through Mailgun (Sinch), whose servers are in the United States. The anti-robot check is Cloudflare Turnstile.
How long: until you unsubscribe. Unsubscribing deletes your address from the list at once.

Your rights: access, correction, deletion and withdrawal of consent, at any time, through the contact form. Under Québec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25), the person in charge is Oussama Abid.
